{{Top|leg}}
'''The Lovers' Embrace''' was when the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]], [[Sharene]] and [[Lodos (moon)|Lodos]], were only a handspan apart when viewed from the surface. During the event, [[Elroodian]] couples exchanged gifts, love poems, and stories, and took vacations. The start of romances and marriages were common during this period. The event happened three times a year, and lasted for several [[Local day/Legends|days]]. A similar event on Elrood was known as [[The Lovers' Conflict]], and the [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] "[[The Lovers' Dilemma]]" was displayed on the same planet.
